description: Perform Bader charge analysis on bulk alpha-Fe2O3 (hematite).
user_prompt: Perform Bader charge analysis on bulk alpha-Fe2O3 (hematite structure, R-3c). Report the Bader net charge (in electrons) for Fe atoms and O atoms.

method.rationale: Values from Pan, Ao & Qin 2020 (spin-polarized PBE+U, Dudarev U-J=4.3 eV on Fe 3d, AFM): for pristine bulk hematite they report the Fe atom loses 1.72 e and the O atom obtains 1.15 e by Bader analysis. The key_parameters are the recommended VASP protocol. Tolerance +/-0.20 e absolute (bulk); residual U-value / PAW-valence dependence stays within it.
